newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee broadly higher, eyes on weather.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee broadly higher, eyes on weather.

text.p: LIFFE robusta coffee futures bucked pre-opening expectations to forge higher into the morning close on Tuesday with concerns over cold weather in Brazil providing the background support.
"The market is slowly and surely making its way up," said one trader.
There was no specific news but traders said the Brazilian weather remained the overriding concern. "This could be an interesting weekend," the trader said.

"Consider now that the traders could be going home on Thursday night without a clear idea of what they will face on Monay morning, then it is not unreasonable to suggest that there will probably be a lot more short covering," broker GNI said.
New York's arabica futures were firmer on talk Brazil's coffee belt could face a colder temperature this weekend. The U.S. market is closed on Friday for the Fourth of July holiday.
A significant polar air mass might pass the coffee areas from the evening of July 5 which could represent the greatest frost threat seen so far this year, Brazil's meteorologists Somar said.
But some U.S. forecasters said although a cooler weather was expected, no crop-damaging frost was seen.
Overall volume in London reached a scant 1,309 lots.
Tuesday is the first tender day for July contract. But no postings were reported yet.
